            + rate.lo.toFixed(2) + " to " + rate.hi.toFixed(2) + " lb/week."
          : "The stored history does not establish a measured weekly rate yet." },
    ];
    return out.map((s) => ({ heading: s.heading, body: s.body || "No supporting estimate is available." }));
